hypotheses.rationale: Strong prior from Days 0-3. Day 6 shows only mundane domestic activity (dishes), consistent with a traveler resting at home on Sunday. No evidence contradicts this.

Laptop was at desk on Day 3. If it remains there on Day 6, it supports WFH. However, the lack of any work-related movement (opening/closing laptop, moving to different rooms) on Day 6 keeps this probability low.
The structured Tue-Sun trip pattern suggests regularity rather than occasional leisure. No new evidence to support this over Business Traveler.
